figs.name: types-of-thermocouples-seebeck-junction-diagram
figs.alt: thermocouple hot junction and reference end with two dissimilar metal wires and millivolt meter
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a thermocouple works: two dissimilar metal wires joined at a hot junction create a small Seebeck voltage read by the instrument.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 470" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Thermocouple construction with hot junction, two dissimilar wires and voltmeter</title>
<rect width="800" height="470" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How a Thermocouple Makes a Voltage</text>
<rect x="40" y="110" width="200" height="200" rx="14" fill="#fff1e6" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="8 5"/>
<text x="140" y="140" font-size="19" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Process heat</text>
<circle cx="150" cy="210" r="13" fill="#c2410c" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="140" y="270" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hot junction</text>
<text x="140" y="294" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">(measuring end)</text>
<polyline points="160,202 300,170 560,170" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="5"/>
<polyline points="160,218 300,250 560,250" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="5"/>
<text x="420" y="158" font-size="18" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Metal A, for example iron</text>
<text x="420" y="285" font-size="18" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Metal B, for example constantan</text>
<rect x="560" y="150" width="30" height="120" rx="4" fill="#e5e7eb" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="575" y="128" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reference end</text>
<polyline points="590,170 650,170 650,185" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<polyline points="590,250 650,250 650,235" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="650" cy="210" r="27" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="650" y="217" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">mV</text>
<text x="700" y="275" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Instrument</text>
<text x="700" y="298" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">reads mV</text>
<rect x="60" y="340" width="680" height="100" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="372.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Seebeck effect</text>
<text x="400.0" y="396.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">A temperature difference between the two ends of two dissimilar metals</text>
<text x="400.0" y="420.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">generates a small voltage that the instrument converts to temperature.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: types-of-thermocouples-temperature-range-chart
figs.alt: types of thermocouples and their ranges bar chart from Type K to Type B
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing thermocouple types K, J, T, E, N, S, R and B by temperature range, from minus 200 °C up to 1700 °C for Type B.

figs.name: types-of-thermocouples-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: thermocouple selection flowchart by process temperature, atmosphere and duty
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to choose between thermocouple types by temperature, cryogenic duty, continuous operation and atmosphere, then sheath, wire size and accuracy.
figs.after_h2: Thermocouple Selection Based on Process Application
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Thermocouple selection flowchart by process application</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Choosing a Thermocouple Type</text>
<polygon points="210,72.0 360.0,115 210,158.0 60.0,115" fill="#fff1e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="121.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Above 1400 °C?</text>
<line x1="362" y1="115" x2="440" y2="115" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="105" font-size="17" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="445" y="80" width="320" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="605.0" y="109.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Type S, R or B</text>
<text x="605.0" y="133.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">glass, steel, lab furnaces</text>
<line x1="210" y1="159" x2="210" y2="182" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="232" y="176" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<polygon points="210,187.0 360.0,230 210,273.0 60.0,230" fill="#fff1e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="236.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sub zero or cryogenic?</text>
<line x1="362" y1="230" x2="440" y2="230" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="220" font-size="17" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="445" y="195" width="320" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="605.0" y="224.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Type T</text>
<text x="605.0" y="248.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">food, pharma, cryogenic tanks</text>
<line x1="210" y1="274" x2="210" y2="297" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="232" y="291" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<polygon points="210,302.0 360.0,345 210,388.0 60.0,345" fill="#fff1e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="351.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Continuous high temp?</text>
<line x1="362" y1="345" x2="440" y2="345" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="335" font-size="17" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="445" y="310" width="320" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="605.0" y="339.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Type N</text>
<text x="605.0" y="363.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">low drift, long life</text>
<line x1="210" y1="389" x2="210" y2="412" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="232" y="406" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<polygon points="210,417.0 360.0,460 210,503.0 60.0,460" fill="#fff1e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="466.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Oxidizing, general use?</text>
<line x1="362" y1="460" x2="440" y2="460" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="450" font-size="17" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="445" y="425" width="320" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="605.0" y="454.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Type K</text>
<text x="605.0" y="478.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">boilers, furnaces</text>
<line x1="210" y1="504" x2="210" y2="527" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="232" y="521" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="60" y="530" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="552.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Type J (to 750 °C)</text>
<text x="210.0" y="575.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">or Type E for high output</text>
<rect x="445" y="526" width="320" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="605.0" y="552.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Then check</text>
<text x="605.0" y="575.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sheath, wire size, accuracy</text>
<line x1="362" y1="558" x2="440" y2="558" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
</svg>
